## 3. Results Breakdown by Acceptance Tier

### Tier 1: Feature Coverage (4 Tests, 100% Pass)
- `Tier1_FeatureCoverage_AllRequiredColorAndBrushTokensExistInDarkAndLightPalettes`:
  - Verifies presence of all 26 required token bases in both `ThemeDark.xaml` and `ThemeLight.xaml`:
    Background (`Brush.Background`, `Brush.Surface`, `Brush.SurfaceElevated`, `Brush.SurfaceHover`, `Brush.SurfacePressed`),
    Foreground (`Brush.Foreground.Primary`, `Secondary`, `Tertiary`, `Disabled`, `OnAccent`),
    Accent (`Brush.Accent`, `Hover`, `Pressed`),
    Border (`Brush.Border`, `Focus`, `Disabled`, `GridLine`),
    Semantic (`Brush.Success`, `Warning`, `Danger`, `Info`),
    Technical Rebar Canvas (`Brush.Canvas.Fill`, `MainBar`, `MainBar.Selected`, `Stirrup`, `Bound`, `Tag`).
  - Validates that color values match `#RRGGBB` or `#AARRGGBB` hex format.
- `Tier1_FeatureCoverage_MaterialBridgeMergesMaterialDesign2Defaults`:
  - Verifies `MaterialBridge.xaml` merges `pack://application:,,,/MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf;component/Themes/MaterialDesign2.Defaults.xaml`.
  - Verifies brand primary (`#0696D7` Revit blue) and secondary (`#E0641E` steel orange) colors in `CustomColorTheme`.
- `Tier1_FeatureCoverage_SegoeUiFontOverrideIsActive`:
  - Verifies `MaterialBridge.xaml` overrides `MaterialDesignFont` to `Segoe UI`.
  - Verifies zero occurrences of `{md:MaterialDesignFont}` markup.
- `Tier1_FeatureCoverage_ImplicitStylesCoverStandardControls`:
  - Verifies implicit style coverage for standard controls: `TextBox`, `ComboBox`, `CheckBox`, `RadioButton`, `Button`, `DataGrid`, `TabControl`.
  - Verifies that `Theme.xaml` merges `MaterialBridge.xaml` which merges `MaterialDesign2.Defaults.xaml`.

### Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases (2 Tests, 100% Pass)
- `Tier2_BoundaryAndCorner_ThemeDarkAndLightTokensAreSymmetric`:
  - Verifies exact 1:1 mathematical set bijection between `ThemeDark.xaml` and `ThemeLight.xaml` tokens.
  - Ensures zero asymmetric token drift between Dark and Light mode dictionaries.
- `Tier2_BoundaryAndCorner_AllReferencedDictionariesUseValidPackUris`:
  - Verifies all merged pack URIs in `Theme.xaml` (`pack://application:,,,/HPRebar;component/...`) resolve to existing physical files on disk.

### Tier 3: Cross-Module Combinations (1 Test, 100% Pass)
- `Tier3_CrossModule_McpBridgeThemeResolvesAllComponentsProperly`:
  - Verifies `HPRebar.McpBridge/Resources/Themes/Theme.xaml` exists and defines valid pack URIs under `pack://application:,,,/HPRebar.McpBridge;component/`.
  - Verifies `HPRebar.McpBridge.csproj` links the required XAML dictionaries from `HPRebar` (`..\HPRebar\Resources\Themes\*.xaml`).
  - Verifies `HPRebar.McpBridge.csproj` links the required C# theme infrastructure (`MaterialThemeBridge.cs`, `RevitHostTheme.cs`, `IHostTheme.cs`, `ThemeInfo.cs`).

### Tier 4: Real-World Packaging Contracts (3 Tests, 100% Pass)
- `Tier4_PackagingContract_ZeroRobotoPackUrisAcrossAllXamlFiles`:
  - Scans all `*.xaml` files in `HPRebar` and `HPRebar.McpBridge`.
  - Strips XML comments and verifies strictly zero active references to "Roboto" or `{md:MaterialDesignFont}`.
- `Tier4_PackagingContract_PaletteHelperIsNowhereInSourceCode`:
  - Scans all `*.cs` and `*.xaml` files across both projects.
  - Verifies strictly zero invocations of `PaletteHelper` in active source code (protecting in-process Revit add-in lifecycle where `Application.Current` does not exist).
- `Tier4_PackagingContract_ILRepackAndPackagingIsolationAreConfigured`:
  - Verifies `HPRebar/HPRebar.csproj` specifies `<IsRepackable>true</IsRepackable>`.
  - Verifies `HPRebar.McpBridge/HPRebar.McpBridge.csproj` defines target `RepackMaterialDesign` merging `MaterialDesignThemes.Wpf.dll`, `MaterialDesignColors.dll`, and `Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors.dll`.
  - Verifies `ThemeInfo.cs` declares `[assembly: ThemeInfo]` with `ResourceDictionaryLocation.SourceAssembly`.
